name: Currents MCP Server
description: Lets coding agents read Currents CI test results, including runs, failures with evidence, and flaky or slow tests, then quarantine tests, file Jira issues, or cancel runs.

skills.name: Run Failure Triage
skills.description: Lists runs and reads failed tests with their evidence and history so an agent can diagnose and fix CI failures.

skills.name: Flaky And Slow Test Ranking
skills.description: Ranks flaky tests, slow spec files, and recurring errors across a project from Currents analytics.

skills.name: Test Quarantine Actions
skills.description: Creates, updates, enables, or disables Currents actions such as quarantining a test.

skills.name: Jira Issue Filing
skills.description: Opens or links Jira issues for failing tests in the Jira instance connected to Currents.

skills.name: Run Control
skills.description: Cancels, resets, or deletes recorded runs, including cancelling runs started from GitHub CI.
